## Project Summary

**What it is:** An NCLEX-PN remediation study planner for Canadian RPN candidates. It reads a JSON file of missed-question tags and generates a 7-day study plan with PN-scope guidance. Runs locally as a Python CLI with zero dependencies or network calls.

**Rules to follow:**
- Standard library only, no external packages or network
- Never include actual question text from paid qbanks (UWorld, Archer, Kaplan); topic tags and personal notes only
- All plan text must use PN scope of practice (reinforce, monitor, report, follow care plan)—not RN scope
- Store everything in plain JSON files (no database, no packaging)
- Single motivation counter only: "days studied in a row" (no other gamification)

**Still owed before sharing:** A scope-of-practice review by someone with nursing background. The plan templates and rendered text need to be checked against actual RPN guidelines to ensure no RN-scope wording crept in. rule (obligation) marks this as non-negotiable before showing to the study group.
